saveIsolationPatch.change: Install and launch under the host identity, independently of MIDlet-Name. Copy legacy RMS/config only when the installed JAR matches exactly and its save is unclaimed or claimed by this identity. Never overwrite or remove legacy saves.

bluetoothPatch.change: Add the missing LocalDevice identity API used by Ninja School 1. The host supplies a per-installation virtual address persisted in localStorage via CheerpJ javaProperties. No host Bluetooth access or Bluetooth networking is implemented; unavailable persistent identity throws BluetoothStateException.

bluetoothApiPatch.change: Complete the javax.bluetooth API so Bluetooth multiplayer MIDlets (e.g. Art Of War 2 Bluetooth, NoClassDefFoundError: javax/bluetooth/UUID) can start. Adds UUID, DiscoveryAgent, L2CAPConnection, L2CAPConnectionNotifier and the rest of LocalDevice; replaces DataElement and the three exceptions, whose bundled constructors were package-private. No Bluetooth networking: inquiries and service searches complete with nothing found, hosting (setDiscoverable) throws BluetoothStateException.

change: List.renderScreen skips null optional menu icons; all other class behavior is preserved.
